name: Location (when in use)
description: Asks for when-in-use location permission and returns the current position with Core Location's async updates, with clear denied and unavailable states.

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is used to show what is near you.

usage: Inject `any LocationProviding` (the live `LocationService` or `PreviewLocationProvider`). Call `try await currentLocation()` when the user asks for something nearby, not at launch; it requests permission the first time. Handle `LocationError.denied` by showing `LocationDeniedView`, which links to Settings. Rewrite `NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription` in the spec to say exactly why this app needs location.
statusNote: Not yet built on a Mac; run `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify location-services` on a Mac with Xcode.
